about_title: A trusted logistics partner based in Ras Al Khor.
about_p1: A W J TRANSPORT LLC is a transportation, logistics, and customs clearing company providing complete logistics solutions across the UAE.
about_p2: We specialize in sea freight container transportation, import and export customs clearance, documentation, port handling, cargo delivery, and business registration support. Our experienced team manages the complete logistics process — from company and account registration for logistics and customs purposes, to customs documentation, port clearance, container transportation, and final delivery. We assist businesses with the procedures and documentation required to establish and operate their logistics and customs activities smoothly and efficiently.

services.title: Sea Freight Container Transportation
services.description: 20ft and 40ft container haulage for import and export cargo, coordinated directly with port schedules across the UAE.

services.title: Customs Clearance & Documentation

services.title: Port Handling & Clearance

services.title: Reefer & Dry Container Delivery
services.description: Temperature-controlled reefer container delivery with genset service, alongside standard dry container haulage.

services.title: Flatbed Trailer Transport

services.title: Business & Logistics Registration Support
